facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are announced once a year.
The application for a specific program or university is made according to the respective announcement on the internet.
There are separate application procedures for European and worldwide programs.
The announcement and selection for the worldwide programs take place before the selection for the European programs.
If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, you can apply for the European exchange within the framework of the Erasmus+ program without restrictions.
The announcements for worldwide and European exchanges are published at the end of October with an application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
